541)rig 'dus sogs kyi skabs don la/lha bskyed mjug gidzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥnas mtshams sbyar gyi dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/rang gi snying ga'i sogs/dza dza sta

tei:div.tei:p: rig 'dus sogs kyi skabs don la/ lha bskyed mjug gi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nas mtshams sbyar gyi dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ dza dza st+wam nas rang gzhung gi spyan 'dren la 'jug bstod 'gor mtshams sbyar gyi sman mchod 'dzud dgos/ nang sgrub ni gzhung gi lha bskyed dang mthun na mtshams sgrub kyi dgug thun dang*/ nus thun gyi las byang byed nas 'don/ bgegs srung byin mchod sogs gzhan nas 'dzud mi dgos/ gsang sgrub kyi sngags tshan gsum po 'bum ther tsam bsags na/ spyi dril sngags khri tsho tsam bzla/ yang na sngags tshan gsum po'i 'tshab tu spyi dril gyi sngags gcig pu bzlas kyang chog sman sgrub ni dpa' bo gcig sgrub yin la/ las byang gi gzhung bsrang nas/ 'dzab kyi skabs su sman skam rlon gang ltar bsgrub kyang rang gzhung bzhin du bsgrubs nas/ rang gi rgyun sten gyi sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sogs kyi dam tshig gi rten du bza' rgyu yin/ nang sgrub dang*/ gsang sgrub kyi tshogs bsdus bza' tshogs dang*/ rgyun tshogs kyi skabs su 'don dgos pa yin no/ ༈ rta mgrin gyi 'gor skabs don lha bskyed mjug gi lhun gyis grub: 542) nas mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ dza dza st+wam nas/ rang gzhung gi gtso dang 'khor bcas sogs nas rang gzhung gar dang*/ bstod 'gor sman mchod 'dzud dgos/ tshogs kyi bskang ba la/ mtshams sbyar gyi bskang rdzas byin brlabs mi dgos/ rta mgrin gyi 'dzab skabs su/ hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen sogs/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis rdzogs mthar/ nang sgrub las/ rigs lnga'i thugs kar sogs/ 'grub par bsam: oṃ badzra kro ta sogs sngags tshan re re bzhin brgya rtsa bzla/ lhan cig tu sbrel mi dgos/ gzhung gi hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen sogs/ 'grub par bsam: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ hrīḥpadma sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: las sbyor gyi grangs ltar bzla/ nang sgrub las/ dpa' bo yab yum

sogs/ bsgom: gzhung gi oṃ hrīḥpadma sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: nang sgrub las/ raḥtsaḥhrīḥyaḥ sogs/ shaḥnaḥ gzhung gi shantiṃ puṣṭiṃ sogs/ rbad dzaḥ nyer lnga sogs skabs dang bstun/ bsdu na sde brgyad sngags kyang dor/ nang sgrub kyi 'dzab sngags rnams ni gtor bzlog gi 'di gar 'don dgos/ dbang sgrub sogs bsdus pa rnams la 'don mi dgos/ ༈ phur pa'i lha bskyed mjug gi rol par smin nas: 543) mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ dza dzaḥst+wam nas/ gzhung gi spyan 'dren ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings 'gyur ba sogs nas rang gzhung ltar dang*/ mtshams sgrub skabs kyi las byang gnyis pa sogs la rang gzhung ltar 'don dgos/ mtshams sbyar gyi dbang bskur rgyas gdab 'dzud mi dgos/ ༈ rgyun srol sogs la chad tho'i 'gor gtor 'gugs 'don mi dgos/ bdag mdun gyi sogs byin brlab dgos/ gtor bzlog skabs kyi nyin rjes mar chad tho zor bsgyur gyi chad tho'i mgor gtor 'gugs 'don dgos so/ gter ston nyid kyi zhal rgyun ltar tshul rdor pas so/ dge'o//
